note: Application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Table, Form, Tools, Window, Help and their sub-items
Application toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard office suite actions like New, Open, Save, Print, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, and formatting controls
Application status bar -- renders fixed operator labels and computed status indicators like page number, zoom level, and cursor position
